saw_lines: Support buyers check how returns work before they order, since a wrong size is a sleeve they cannot wear.
So a buyer who doubts the fit scrolls past, since the risk never gets answered in the first line.
Your site shows 2,713 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads show that count, so put 2,713 on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 2,713 reviews, yet 0 of 30 ads show any of those counts, so a buyer clicking through meets proof the ad never mentioned. Put 2,713 on the creative and open two ads with a named review quote.

9 ads say 3500 reviews, 7 say 3500 customers, and 2 say 100000+ customers, so a buyer gets conflicting stories. Retire both customer claims and pick a single verified figure, the 2,713 review count, then use it on every creative.

Your site promises a 30 day money back guarantee, yet 0 of 19 ads mention it while 17 push a discount. A hesitant buyer has no reason to click. Open 3 ads with the guarantee and put it on the creative.

Your site explains how orders ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a new buyer must leave the ad to find out. Answer it in the first line of ads for new buyers, naming free UK shipping.

ads_1: Knee-support creative opening on the guarantee and the 2,713 review count
